base_commit_semantics: Exact verified source base for this proposal. Before recording ACTIVE_TASK, master pins the then-current accepted commit. If it differs only by adopted F00/control documents, retain source hashes and record that new exact commit without a full audit; any runtime difference requires focused reconciliation.
proposed_owner_role: Single F01 feature worker appointed by the Astra master
dependencies: F00 master acceptance of revision 2 proposals, at minimum D01 and D10
No other active feature lease or conflicting writer
Fresh exact program HEAD and clean/preserved worktree; dedicated host metadata checked before any later transfer

Material/selection presentation and role handling, including renaming Light blue fills to Surface fills; preserve gesture, navigation and renderer lifecycle.
path_constraints.spatial-source/web/tests/ui/workflow.spe: One focused surface-contrast scenario or bounded extension of the existing graphic 3D scenario; no broad suite expansion.
path_constraints.tests: Changed-risk assertions only; generated screenshots/results are ephemeral or returned as F01 evidence, not new runtime/config paths.

forbidden_without_master_amendment: Publishing, signing, installation, or business-record binding

focused_acceptance.check: One small-screen room: wall > ceiling > floor luminance, both unselected and selected; representative orbit and walk. Use existing syntheticDocument fixture and preserve geometry.
Same scenario covers ceiling toggle, the Surface fills label and fill-disabled mode, cutaway and semantic picking. Legacy floor/ceiling room ownership remains intact until F03.

Table-driven helper proves explicit roles/triangle ownership and sRGB-to-linear intended colors; existing GLB test checks opaque wall/floor factors and unchanged geometry identity. State that display ceilings are not exported.

Bounded role batches (at most three structural roles), existing idle/warm-renderer instrumentation, no new animation loop or per-object materials. Run only the existing relevant warm-idle case, not stress/timing suites.

Receipt separates source commit/build/UI evidence, host transfer/hash/build/served status, Apple asset/build/device status and OS status. Missing target verification stays open, not passed by source equality.

suggested_commands_from_source_web: npx playwright test --config tests/ui/playwright.config.ts workflow.spec.ts --grep "surface contrast"
npx playwright test --config tests/ui/warm-switch.config.ts warm-switch.spec.ts --grep "warm renderer stays idle"
command_notes: surface contrast is the proposed focused scenario title, not an existing passing test. Install/reuse pinned dependencies and the current browser setup as needed; these commands were not run in F00. If extending the existing 3D test instead, select its actual title. Build once per relevant accepted candidate.
master_recording_steps: Review F00 patch and record accepted decision revision without claiming prior acceptance.
Re-read ACTIVE_TASK; if any task is active, preserve it and reconcile the conflict, never overwrite.
Pin the exact accepted program commit and verify the bounded input hashes; appoint one worker.
Record a single ACTIVE_TASK for F01 with that base, owner, allowed_paths and required_acceptance. Update the existing source BUILD_QUEUE rather than creating another queue.
Supply accepted documents and the source at the recorded base to the F01 chat; stop after F01.
stop_after: F01 handoff to master; do not begin F02
